# Trend Smoothing – Reducing Noise

```{python}
#| echo: false
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
```

Noisy data? A **moving average** smooths curves:

```{python}
#| fig-alt: "Visualization of data forming a waveform from left to right. The smoothed curve is overlaid on top."

data = np.genfromtxt("01-daten/trenddaten-mit-rauschen.csv", delimiter=",", skip_header=1)
x = data[:, 0]
y = data[:, 1]

window = 5
weights = np.ones(window) / window
y_smooth = np.convolve(y, weights, mode='valid')

plt.plot(x, y, label="Original", alpha=0.5)
plt.plot(x[(window-1)//2:-(window//2)], y_smooth, label="Smoothed", color='red')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.title("Trend Smoothing")

plt.show()
```
